info.name: List all flags for an environment

params.name: feature
params.description: Optional feature name to filter flags. When provided, returns only the flag matching the specified feature name.

items.docs: Retrieves all feature flags for the environment associated with the provided Environment Key. Returns an array of flag objects, each containing the feature definition, its enabled state, and any associated value. This endpoint is used by client-side SDKs to initialize flag state.
